sourceSpatialReference: EPSG:2246 / NAD 1983 StatePlane Kentucky North FIPS 1601 Feet

optionalLayers.label: County parcels
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: LRSN is the unique GIS parcel key; PARCELID is the parcel identification number; PVA owner/appraisal join is wired through the Jefferson County PVA owner/appraisal index when source data is present
optionalLayers.renderStrategy: build-time ArcGIS fetch, universal parcel mapping, viewport chunks, capped runtime loader

optionalLayers.label: Address intelligence
optionalLayers.source: LOJIC Jefferson County KY Address Points
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: direct PARCELID to accountNum join with LRSN to gisParcelId fallback; no address geocoding inference
optionalLayers.renderStrategy: build-time attribute fetch, exact parcel-key join, and hashed address-index shards for viewport-bounded lookup

optionalLayers.label: Permits and certificates of occupancy
optionalLayers.source: Louisville Metro active construction permits, planning applications, and occupancy case sources
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: active permits use LATITUDE/LONGITUDE point-in-polygon join to LOJIC parcels; 22,717 records joined, 25 valid-location records remain unmatched, and 90 invalid/missing-coordinate records remain quarantined; CO remains source-needed until official bulk source is verified
optionalLayers.renderStrategy: build-time ArcGIS fetch, address/spatial parcel join, then viewport-safe chunks

optionalLayers.label: Development signals
optionalLayers.source: Parcel-joined Louisville Metro active construction permits
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: permit point contained by LOJIC parcel polygon; parcel summaries preserve permit counts, types, latest issue date, active status count, project costs, and source lineage
optionalLayers.renderStrategy: offline point-in-polygon join and viewport-sharded parcel development summaries

optionalLayers.label: PVA owner/appraisal
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: PARCELID to county accountNum first; LRSN to county gisParcelId when present; PIN is candidate-only until verified. Bulk extraction from the subscription search is prohibited without prior written PVA consent, so an authorized bulk export remains required.
optionalLayers.renderStrategy: official PVA export normalized at build time, joined offline into universal parcel records, then served through existing viewport chunks

optionalLayers.label: Zoning intelligence
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: parcel centroid spatial join from county parcel polygons to Jefferson County KY zoning polygons; keyed back to countyParcelId, PARCELID/accountNum, and LRSN/gisParcelId
optionalLayers.renderStrategy: build-time ArcGIS fetch, offline parcel centroid spatial join, viewport-safe sharded parcel lookup

optionalLayers.label: Floodplain intelligence
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: parcel centroid spatial join from county parcel polygons to current FEMA flood zone polygons; keyed back to countyParcelId, PARCELID/accountNum, and LRSN/gisParcelId
optionalLayers.renderStrategy: build-time official floodplain fetch, offline parcel centroid spatial join, viewport-safe sharded parcel lookup

ownerEnrichment.propertyRecordSource: Official Jefferson County PVA Address/Parcel search, subscription search, or records-request export. Bulk file expected at data/raw/jefferson-ky/Jefferson_County_KY_PVA_Owner_Appraisal.csv.
ownerEnrichment.officialJoinKey: PVA PARCELID -> LOJIC PARCELID -> White Rabbit accountNum; PVA LRSN -> LOJIC LRSN -> White Rabbit gisParcelId if included in the export
ownerEnrichment.noOfficialEmailFieldNote: Do not infer owner email. Only map ownerEmail if an official PVA or approved owner/appraisal export explicitly includes it.

joinKeys.primaryParcelAccount: PVA PARCELID -> county parcel PARCELID -> White Rabbit accountNum; LRSN remains the unique GIS parcel key for countyParcelId
joinKeys.appraisal: PVA owner/appraisal export PARCELID -> county parcel PARCELID; value fields map to landValue, improvementValue, totalValue when present
joinKeys.land: PVA owner/appraisal export PARCELID -> county parcel PARCELID; acreage/square-foot fields map to landAreaSize, landAreaSqFt, landAreaUnit when present
joinKeys.secondaryParcelGisId: PVA LRSN -> county parcel LRSN -> White Rabbit gisParcelId when the PVA export includes LRSN; PIN remains fallback candidate only
joinKeys.address: LOJIC address PARCELID -> county parcel accountNum; LRSN -> gisParcelId fallback; 449,474 of 450,857 address points joined
joinKeys.blockLabels: pilot: direct key, spatial join, or unavailable
joinKeys.dimensions: pilot: direct key, spatial join, or unavailable
joinKeys.permits: Louisville Metro active permit LATITUDE/LONGITUDE spatial join to county parcel polygon first; normalized ADDRESS fallback after PVA situs address export; CO source remains pending
joinKeys.zoning: Jefferson County KY zoning parcel centroid spatial join keyed back to countyParcelId, PARCELID/accountNum, and LRSN/gisParcelId
joinKeys.floodplain: Current FEMA flood zone parcel centroid spatial join keyed back to countyParcelId, PARCELID/accountNum, and LRSN/gisParcelId

productionGap: Pilot adapter only. County parcel geometry, viewport chunks, parcel search shards, zoning, floodplain, permit, and development-signal parcel indexes are built. PVA owner/appraisal remains source-needed and rights-gated: the subscription search supports CSV export of search results, but the published terms prohibit broad copying/storage or exploitation without prior written PVA consent. Formal CO bulk source, parcel dimensions, block grid, freshness approval, and PMTiles remain incomplete.
pilotNotes: Do not activate this county in the app until source files are loaded or fetched, schema inspection is complete, exact join keys are verified, and QC warnings are resolved.
